dialogues.speaker: Sealed Orders
dialogues.text: ...all remaining personnel should immediately abandon this machine upon completion of the mission and relocate to the Marshal's machine...

dialogues.speaker: Sealed Orders
dialogues.text: ...it is a pity that due to our limited transportation capacity and the uncontrollable security risks, we can only provide the wounded with sufficient supplies and transfer them to a nearby safe zone for now. We will come back to them later...
